elements.label: Figure 2.17
elements.description:
Two line charts side by side, with quintiles Q1 (Bottom 20) to Q5 (Top 20) on the x-axis and three series: Registered business, Small household business, and No registration. Values are not printed, so approximate readings are given.

Left panel: y-axis 'Share of households (%)', scale 0-25.
- Registered business: ~0, ~0.7, ~0.9, ~1.3, ~2.4
- Small household business: ~3.5, ~10.4, ~12.5, ~16.6, ~21.1
- No registration: ~12.2, ~17.6, ~21.0, ~21.1, ~17.8

Right panel: y-axis 'Annual income (VND, millions)', scale 0-600.
- Registered business: ~190, ~120, ~150, ~175, ~520
- Small household business: ~60, ~100, ~135, ~165, ~210
- No registration: ~40, ~75, ~95, ~118, ~160

Note: Household-level income. Source: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2020. Pattern: the share of small household businesses rises steeply across quintiles, while registered business income rises sharply only in the top quintile.

elements.label: Figure 2.18
elements.description:
Two grouped bar charts with quintiles Q1 (Bottom 20) to Q5 (Top 20) on the x-axis and two series: 2010 (teal) and 2020 (orange). Values are not printed, so approximate readings are given.

Left panel: y-axis 'Share of households (%)', scale 0-25.
- 2010: ~10.6, ~5.6, ~4.5, ~3.2, ~1.7
- 2020: ~22.3, ~12.5, ~9.1, ~7.1, ~6.6

Right panel: y-axis 'Annual income (VND, millions)', scale 0-7.
- 2010: ~2.1, ~2.8, ~4.5, ~4.7, ~4.0
- 2020: ~4.5, ~5.0, ~5.9, ~5.6, ~6.0

Note: Annual household nominal income among recipients. Source: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2010 and 2020. Pattern: the share of recipient households falls across quintiles in both years, and income rises from 2010 to 2020 in every quintile.

elements.label: Table 2.2
elements.description:
| CATEGORIES OF EXISTING VULNERABLE GROUPS | ESTIMATED NUMBER OF BENEFICIARIES | AVERAGE BENEFIT AMOUNT (MONTHLY) |
|---|---|---|
| Whole country | | |
| People in poor and near-poor households | 7 million people | VND 750,000 per person |
| Social assistance beneficiaries | 2.84 million people | VND 1.5 million per person |
| Merit people (National Devotees) | 1 million people | VND 1.5 million per person |

Note: Merit people (or National Devotees) are people who have contributed during revolution and war times. Dutta (2019) estimates for 2018 are used.
